Name: Super Staircase
Author: YuGk
Description:
[b]Now you can make staircase with jade instead of purchase from desert trader every Sunday![/b]
Add Deca Staircase allow you jump 10 layers once, unlock with mining level 4, make from 10 jades or 10 normal staircases.
Add Super Staircase allow you jump 100 layers once, make from 150 jades by default, cost can be optimized with GMCM or local config file.

现在你可以直接通过翡翠来合成楼梯而不是每周跑去沙漠商人那买楼梯！
添加了新的十级楼梯，可以使用十个翡翠或十个普通楼梯合成，一次可以下十层，挖矿4级解锁。
添加了新的超级楼梯，默认使用150个翡翠合成，一次可以直接下一百层，让你的骷髅矿洞之旅更加轻松！挖矿7级解锁。
可以在配置文件或GMCM中更改合成超级楼梯所需要的翡翠数量。

Manifest.Name: Super Staircase
Manifest.Description: Adds a Super Staircase that drops 100 floors at once. Crafted from Jade. Also adds a 1-Jade-to-Staircase recipe.
